meta.name: testing-dbt-models
meta.description:
Adds schema tests and data quality validation to dbt models. Use when working with dbt tests for:
(1) Adding or modifying tests in schema.yml files
(2) Task mentions "test", "validate", "data quality", "unique", "not_null", or "accepted_values"
(3) Ensuring data integrity - primary keys, foreign keys, relationships
(4) Debugging test failures or understanding why dbt test failed
Matches existing project test patterns and YAML style before adding new tests.

copy.tagline: 为 dbt 模型添加数据质量测试与验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 dbt 做数据建模，需要保证数据完整性
copy.tagline_en: Add data quality tests and validation to dbt models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use dbt for data modeling and need to ensure data integrity

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为 dbt 模型添加 schema 测试和数据质量验证。它会先研究项目现有测试风格，然后为模型的主键、外键、分类列等添加 unique、not_null、accepted_values 等测试，并运行 dbt test 检查结果。
howto.when: 当你在 dbt 项目中提到“测试”、“验证”、“数据质量”、“unique”、“not_null”或“accepted_values”等关键词，或者要求添加或修改 schema.yml 文件中的测试时触发。

say.text: 为我的 orders 模型添加主键 unique 和 not_null 测试。
帮我调试 dbt test 中 unique 测试失败的原因。
say.note: Claude 会检查失败日志并给出修复建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds schema tests and data quality validation to dbt models. It first studies existing project test patterns, then adds tests like unique, not_null, accepted_values for primary keys, foreign keys, categorical columns, etc., and runs dbt test to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "test", "validate", "data quality", "unique", "not_null", or "accepted_values" in a dbt project, or when you ask to add or modify tests in schema.yml files.

say_en.text: Add unique and not_null tests for my orders model's primary key.
say_en.note: Claude reads the model SQL and adds tests to schema.yml.

say_en.text: Check which columns in my staging model need accepted_values tests.
Help me debug why the unique test failed in dbt test.
say_en.note: Claude examines failure logs and suggests fixes.
